In detail

Eastern residential Parma. Named alongside the centre, San Leonardo and Oltretorrente in the grouping that accounts for over 70% of the episodes in the opposition group's 2026 crime map, though its own share of that total is small. Residential, with little visitor traffic.

Frequently asked questions

Is Lubiana safe?

Wandroz currently rates Lubiana in Parma as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Parma at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Parma publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Lubiana safe at night?

At night, Lubiana is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Parma. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Lubiana a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Lubiana's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Lubiana?

Not an official government crime feed — Lubiana's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
